svg.title: DOS Warp Creature: writer and local recalculation
svg.desc: Conditional named routing reaches the Warp writer after a positive resistance result. MoM 1.31 retries selected existing bits; CP 1.60 and CoM1 use a bounded cascade. MoM1.31 and1.60 then call constructor and battlefield routines. CoM1 skips that local tail. Full calculator pass equivalence remains unproved.
svg.text: Warp Creature: cast state first, recalculation is versioned
F250.3 · 668 supplied instructions · raw SPELLDAT binding remains conditional on runtime loading
Record 89 → class 5 → common opaque call → local id 89
82B84 / 82D59 · tests use live state after calls; excluded siblings remain external
Resistance call result > 0 → invoke writer at AE020
82D91 → 82DA3 · nonpositive result skips the writer, then joins the versioned tail
MoM 1.31 · stack argument supplies SI
Opaque call(3): result 1 / 2 / 3
→ Attack / Defense / Resistance bit
Already set? Retry. Other negative result? Retry.
Other nonnegative results exit without a store.
No random distribution or termination guarantee established.
CP 1.60 / CoM1 · inherited SI
Bounded cascade: call(3), then call(2), then call(2)
Select available bits through ordered fallbacks.
Every completed path performs one OR-store.
Final fallback may OR an already-set Defense bit.
ES:BX explicitly saved/restored around each opaque call.
Store, if reached: Combat_Effects |= 0080 / 0100 / 0200
1.31 / 1.60: known recalculation pair
BU_Construct → BU_Apply_Battlefield_Effects
82DFD / 82E16 · byte7 compare/write surrounds the pair.
This local tail also runs when the writer was skipped.
CoM1: skips the entire local rebuild tail
82DA9 → external continuation at 82E53
Known consumers do not prove when they run on this path.
Later scheduling remains outside this bounded unit.
Full calculator pass equivalence: not established. Preserve battle inputs, both Specials calls and intermediate state.
